title.en: The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber

note.en: Zhang Wuji and the fight over the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Saber. The third book of the Condor Trilogy.
note.zh: 張無忌與倚天劍、屠龍刀之爭。「射鵰三部曲」的第三部。

title.en: The Legend of the Condor Heroes

note.en: Guo Jing, raised on the Mongolian steppe, and the clever Huang Rong. The first book of the Condor Trilogy.
note.zh: 在蒙古草原長大的郭靖與聰慧的黃蓉。「射鵰三部曲」的第一部。

title.en: The Return of the Condor Heroes

note.en: Yang Guo and his teacher Xiaolongnü. The second book of the Condor Trilogy.
note.zh: 楊過與小龍女的故事。「射鵰三部曲」的第二部。

note.en: Chen Jialuo and the Red Flower Society in the Qianlong era. Jin Yong’s first novel.
note.zh: 乾隆年間，陳家洛與紅花會。金庸的第一部小說。

note.en: Three sworn brothers, Qiao Feng, Duan Yu, and Xuzhu, in the Northern Song era.
note.zh: 北宋年間，喬峰、段譽與虛竹三兄弟的故事。

note.en: At the fall of the Sui, two street kids from Yangzhou, Kou Zhong and Xu Ziling, rise to shape the empire.
note.zh: 隋末亂世，揚州的兩個小混混寇仲與徐子陵，一步步成為改變天下的人物。

note.en: In the last years of the Southern Song, Liang Xiao builds martial arts on mathematics and is swept into the war between Song and Yuan.
note.zh: 南宋末年的梁蕭，把數學與算學融入武功，捲入宋元之間的戰亂。

note.en: Xu Fengnian, heir of the Prince of Beiliang, and his journey through the jianghu and the empire.
note.zh: 北涼世子徐鳳年的江湖與天下。

note.en: The free-spirited swordsman Linghu Chong amid rivalries among the martial schools.
note.zh: 灑脫的令狐沖，在各大門派的明爭暗鬥之中。

note.en: Wei Xiaobao, a streetwise boy who rises in the Kangxi Emperor’s court. Jin Yong’s last full-length novel.
note.zh: 市井出身的韋小寶，在康熙朝廷中左右逢源。金庸的最後一部長篇小說。

note.en: Yuan Chengzhi at the end of the Ming dynasty.
note.zh: 明朝末年，袁承志的故事。

note.en: Shi Potian, a guileless young man who is mistaken for someone else.
note.zh: 單純的少年石破天，被誤認為他人的奇遇。

note.en: Di Yun, a country boy betrayed and imprisoned, and the secret of a hidden treasure.
note.zh: 被陷害入獄的鄉下少年狄雲，與一個寶藏的秘密。

note.en: The youth of Hu Fei, before Fox Volant of the Snowy Mountain.
note.zh: 胡斐的少年時代，《雪山飛狐》的前傳。

title.en: Fox Volant of the Snowy Mountain

note.en: An old feud between the Hu and Miao families, told over a single day.
note.zh: 胡、苗兩家的恩怨，在一天之內娓娓道來。

title.en: White Horse Neighs in the Western Wind

note.en: Li Wenxiu, a Han girl who grows up among the Kazakhs.
note.zh: 在哈薩克族之間長大的漢族少女李文秀。

note.en: A lighthearted novella about the pair of Mandarin Duck Blades.
note.zh: 圍繞一對鴛鴦刀的輕鬆中篇小說。

note.en: A short story set in the Spring and Autumn period, about the swordswoman Aqing.
note.zh: 春秋時代，越國少女阿青的短篇故事。

note.en: Ning Que, a young soldier from the frontier, enters the Academy with his maid Sang Sang and begins to cultivate.
note.zh: 邊城少年寧缺帶著小侍女桑桑進入書院，踏上修行之路。

title.en: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality

note.en: Han Li, a village boy of ordinary talent, climbs the path of cultivation through caution and grit.
note.zh: 資質平凡的山村少年韓立，憑謹慎與毅力一步步修仙。

note.en: Xiao Yan, a fallen prodigy who lost his power, rises again with the help of the spirit Yao Lao.
note.zh: 天才少年蕭炎鬥氣盡失，在藥老的幫助下重新崛起。

note.en: Mo Fan wakes up in a world where magic has replaced science, and finds he can master more than one element.
note.zh: 莫凡醒來發現世界變成魔法取代科學的地方，而他能同時修煉多種系別。

note.en: Mei Changsu returns to the capital under a new name to clear the names of those wronged twelve years before.
note.zh: 梅長蘇化名重回金陵，為十二年前的冤案翻案。

title.en: Nirvana in Fire II: The Wind Blows in Chang Lin

note.en: The sequel to Nirvana in Fire, following the Changlin Army’s Xiao Pingjing and his brother Xiao Pingzhang.
note.zh: 《琅琊榜》的續作，講述長林軍的蕭平旌與兄長蕭平章。

note.en: Fan Xian, reborn with memories of the modern world, finds his own way through palace intrigue.
note.zh: 帶著現代記憶重生的范閒，在權謀之間走出自己的路。

note.en: Kiyotaka Ayanokōji at an elite school where students are ranked purely on merit. A light novel series.
note.zh: 綾小路清隆在以實力評價學生的高度育成高中裡的校園生活。輕小說系列。

note.en: Lena and the Spearhead squadron of the Eighty-Six fight a war the Republic claims is fought by drones. Based on the light novel by Asato Asato.
note.zh: 蕾娜與「先鋒戰隊」的八六區少年們，在一場共和國宣稱由無人機進行的戰爭中奮戰。改編自安里アサト的輕小說。

note.en: Sōma Yukihira cooks his way through the elite Tōtsuki culinary academy, one food duel at a time. Based on the manga by Yūto Tsukuda and Shun Saeki.
note.zh: 幸平創真在名門遠月料理學園，以一場場「食戟」料理對決一路挑戰。改編自附田祐斗與佐伯俊的漫畫。

note.en: Naruto Uzumaki, an outcast ninja kid, sets out to become Hokage, the leader of his village.
note.zh: 被村人排斥的忍者少年漩渦鳴人，立志成為村子的首領「火影」。

note.en: Piano prodigy Kōsei Arima, who can no longer hear his own playing, meets the free-spirited violinist Kaori Miyazono.
note.zh: 聽不見自己琴聲的鋼琴神童有馬公生，遇見自由奔放的小提琴手宮園薰。

note.en: Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates sail the Grand Line in search of the legendary treasure, the One Piece.
note.zh: 魯夫與草帽海賊團航向偉大航道，尋找傳說中的大秘寶「ONE PIECE」。

title.zh: 果然我的青春戀愛喜劇搞錯了。

note.en: Loner Hachiman Hikigaya is made to join the Service Club with Yukino Yukinoshita and Yui Yuigahama, helping classmates with their problems.
note.zh: 孤僻的比企谷八幡被迫加入「侍奉社」，和雪之下雪乃、由比濱結衣一起替人解決煩惱。

title.en: Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai
title.zh: 青春豬頭少年不會夢到兔女郎學姊

note.en: Sakuta Azusagawa meets Mai Sakurajima, a senpai in a bunny suit whom no one else can see, and runs into one case of “Adolescence Syndrome” after another.
note.zh: 梓川咲太遇見穿著兔女郎裝、卻沒有人看得見的學姊櫻島麻衣，捲入一連串「青春期症候群」。

note.en: Wakana Gojō, who wants to craft hina dolls, and Marin Kitagawa, a cheerful girl who loves cosplay.
note.zh: 想成為雛人形頭師的五條新菜，和熱愛 cosplay 的辣妹喜多川海夢。

note.en: Popular Kyōko Hori and quiet Izumi Miyamura discover each other’s hidden sides outside school.
note.zh: 人氣女孩堀京子和陰沉的宮村伊澄，在校外看見彼此不為人知的一面。

note.en: Badminton player Taiki Inomata has a crush on Chinatsu Kano, a basketball star a year above him, and then she comes to live at his house.
note.zh: 羽球社的豬股大喜暗戀籃球社的學姊鹿野千夏，沒想到兩人竟住進同一個屋簷下。

note.en: Class 3-E has one school year to assassinate their teacher, a super-creature called Koro-sensei.
note.zh: 椚丘中學三年 E 班要在一年內暗殺自己的班導：自稱「殺老師」的超生物。

title.zh: 歡迎來到實力至上主義的教室

note.en: Kiyotaka Ayanokōji hides his true ability at a school where merit decides everything.
note.zh: 綾小路清隆在以實力決定一切的高度育成高中裡，隱藏自己的真正實力。

title.en: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

note.en: Delinquent Chika Kudō joins a koto club with only one member left, Takezō Kurata, and helps bring it back to life.
note.zh: 不良少年久遠愛加入只剩一個人的箏曲社，和社長倉田武藏一起重振社團。

title.zh: 無職轉生～到了異世界就拿出真本事～

note.en: A man who wasted his life is reborn in another world as Rudeus Greyrat, and resolves to live this one properly.
note.zh: 一事無成的男人死後轉生成魯迪烏斯，決定這一次要認真活下去。

title.en: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
title.zh: 關於我轉生變成史萊姆這檔事

note.en: Office worker Satoru Mikami is killed and reborn in another world as a slime named Rimuru.
note.zh: 上班族三上悟遇刺身亡，轉生成異世界的史萊姆「利姆路」。

note.en: Thousands of years after all humans were turned to stone, science-loving Senku sets out to rebuild civilization.
note.zh: 全人類石化數千年後，科學少年千空要靠科學重建文明。

note.en: Gon sets out to become a Hunter and find his father, who is one.
note.zh: 小傑為了尋找身為獵人的父親，踏上成為獵人的旅程。

note.en: After the Titans break through the walls, Eren swears to wipe out every last one.
note.zh: 巨人攻破城牆後，艾連立誓驅逐世界上所有的巨人。

note.en: Asta, born without magic in a world where everyone has it, aims to become the Wizard King.
note.zh: 天生沒有魔力的少年亞斯塔，以成為魔法帝為目標。

note.en: Ashito Aoi from Ehime joins a J-League youth team in Tokyo and is moved from striker to fullback.
note.zh: 愛媛少年青井葦人加入東京的 J 聯盟青年隊，從前鋒轉為後衛。

note.en: Short but fearless Shōyō Hinata teams up with genius setter Tobio Kageyama on Karasuno High’s volleyball team.
note.zh: 個子不高的日向翔陽和天才舉球員影山飛雄，在烏野高中排球部成為搭檔。

note.en: Spy Twilight builds a fake family for a mission, not knowing his wife is an assassin and his daughter reads minds.
note.zh: 間諜「黃昏」為了任務組成假家庭：妻子是殺手，女兒會讀心。

note.en: Nishikata keeps trying to get back at Takagi, the girl next to him who loves to tease him.
note.zh: 西片總想反擊老是捉弄他的鄰座高木同學。

note.en: Zhuge Kongming, the Three Kingdoms strategist, is reborn in modern Shibuya and becomes the tactician for singer Eiko.
note.zh: 三國軍師諸葛孔明轉生到現代澀谷，成為歌手英子的軍師。

note.en: Haiji Kiyose rallies the ten residents of his dorm to run the Hakone Ekiden.
note.zh: 清瀨灰二號召住在竹青莊的十個人，一起挑戰箱根驛傳。

title.en: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
title.zh: 在超市後門抽菸的兩人

note.en: Tired office worker Sasaki unwinds after work by smoking and chatting with Yamada, a clerk, behind the supermarket.
note.zh: 疲憊的上班族佐佐木，下班後在超市後門和店員山田一起抽菸聊天。

note.en: Maomao, an apothecary sold into the imperial palace, solves the court’s mysteries with her knowledge of medicine.
note.zh: 被賣進後宮的藥師少女貓貓，用藥學知識解開宮中的一個個謎團。

note.en: High-school detective Shinichi Kudo is poisoned and shrunk into a child, and keeps solving cases as Conan Edogawa.
note.zh: 高中生偵探工藤新一被灌下毒藥變成小學生，化名江戶川柯南繼續破案。

note.en: Six friends in New York City, their jobs, and their love lives.
note.zh: 六個住在紐約的好朋友，他們的工作、生活與戀愛。

note.en: Caltech physicists Leonard and Sheldon, their friends, and Penny from across the hall.
note.zh: 加州理工的物理學家萊納德和謝爾頓、他們的朋友，還有住對門的潘妮。

note.en: Bored of Hell, Lucifer Morningstar opens a nightclub in Los Angeles and starts consulting for the LAPD.
note.zh: 厭倦地獄的路西法來到洛杉磯開夜店，還當起了洛杉磯警局的顧問。

note.en: After an attack destroys the Capitol, low-ranking cabinet member Tom Kirkman suddenly becomes President.
note.zh: 國會大廈遭到攻擊後，原本不起眼的內閣部長湯姆・柯克曼突然成為美國總統。

note.en: “The Professor” leads a crew code-named after cities in a heist on Spain’s Royal Mint.
note.zh: 「教授」率領一群以城市為代號的搶匪，挾持西班牙皇家造幣廠。

note.en: Beth Harmon, raised in an orphanage, becomes a chess prodigy.
note.zh: 在孤兒院長大的貝絲・哈蒙，成為西洋棋天才。

note.en: Nine-year-old genius Sheldon Cooper starts high school in East Texas.
note.zh: 九歲的天才謝爾頓・庫柏，在德州東部讀高中。

note.en: At a small hospital far from the city, genius surgeon “Teacher Kim” trains young doctors.
note.zh: 在偏遠的小醫院裡，天才外科醫師「金師傅」帶領年輕醫生成長。

note.en: Five friends from medical school work at the same hospital, and play in a band together.
note.zh: 五個醫學院時期的好朋友在同一間醫院工作，還一起組了樂團。

note.en: A paragliding accident lands South Korean heiress Yoon Se-ri in North Korea, where she meets officer Ri Jeong-hyeok.
note.zh: 南韓財閥千金尹世理玩滑翔傘時意外降落北韓，遇見軍官李正赫。

note.en: Woo Young-woo, a brilliant rookie lawyer on the autism spectrum, takes on case after case.
note.zh: 有自閉症類群障礙的天才新人律師禹英禑，接下一件又一件案子。

note.en: Chaebol heiress Hong Hae-in and her husband Baek Hyun-woo, a boy from the countryside, in a marriage in crisis.
note.zh: 財閥千金洪海仁與出身鄉下的丈夫白賢祐，面臨婚姻危機。

note.en: Based on Mao Ni’s novel: Fan Xian grows up in an ancient kingdom with the memories of a modern man.
note.zh: 改編自貓膩的小說：帶著現代人記憶的范閑，在古代王朝長大。

note.en: Based on Hai Yan’s novel: Mei Changsu returns to the capital under a new name to right an old injustice.
note.zh: 改編自海宴的小說：梅長蘇化名重回金陵，為舊案翻案。

note.en: Liu Yifei as Huang Yimei, through love and life from university to middle age.
note.zh: 劉亦菲飾演黃亦玫，從大學到中年的愛情與人生。

note.en: An adaptation of Romance of the Three Kingdoms, from the end of the Han to the unification under Jin.
note.zh: 改編自《三國演義》，從東漢末年一直到三國歸晉。

note.en: The struggle between Liu Bang and Xiang Yu after the fall of the Qin.
note.zh: 秦朝滅亡後，劉邦與項羽的楚漢相爭。

note.en: A detective who can relive the same day five times races to solve a case.
note.zh: 擁有一天能重來五次的能力，刑警丁奇在循環中追查真相。

note.en: Cheng Shaoshang and General Ling Buyi, a love story set in an ancient court.
note.zh: 程少商與凌不疑，古代宮廷裡的愛情故事。

note.en: After a fall from grace in Paris, chef Natsuki Obana (Takuya Kimura) sets out to build a three-Michelin-star restaurant in Tokyo with Rinko Hayami.
note.zh: 在巴黎失勢的主廚尾花夏樹（木村拓哉），與早見倫子在東京打造目標米其林三星的餐廳。

note.en: Andy Dufresne, a banker wrongly jailed for murder, never gives up hope inside Shawshank prison.
note.zh: 被冤枉殺人入獄的銀行家安迪，在肖申克監獄裡從沒放棄希望。

note.en: A businessman and a milk-factory worker share one disaster after another on the Chinese New Year trip home.
note.zh: 春運返鄉的路上，老闆李成功和擠奶工牛耿一路狀況不斷。

note.en: Three friends at an engineering college, and Rancho’s rebellion against learning by rote.
note.zh: 工程學院裡的三個好朋友，和藍丘對填鴨式教育的反叛。

note.en: In 1962, driver Tony Lip takes pianist Don Shirley on a concert tour of the Deep South.
note.zh: 1962 年，司機東尼載著黑人鋼琴家唐・雪利到美國南方巡演。

note.en: J. Robert Oppenheimer and the Manhattan Project.
note.zh: 「原子彈之父」羅伯特・奧本海默與曼哈頓計畫。

note.en: Luke Skywalker, Princess Leia, and Han Solo take on the Galactic Empire.
note.zh: 路克・天行者、莉亞公主與韓・索羅對抗銀河帝國。

note.en: Eight-time Ballon d’Or winner and captain of Argentina’s 2022 FIFA World Cup–winning team.
note.zh: 八度榮獲金球獎，並以隊長身分帶領阿根廷贏得 2022 年世界盃冠軍。

imageCredit.text: Photo: Bryan Berlin / CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

note.en: Holds the record for the most Grand Slam men’s singles titles, and won Olympic gold at Paris 2024.
note.zh: 保持男子網球大滿貫單打冠軍次數紀錄，並在 2024 年巴黎奧運奪得金牌。

imageCredit.text: Photo: Andymiah / CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

note.en: Four-time NBA champion and the league’s all-time leading scorer.
note.zh: 四度贏得 NBA 總冠軍，也是 NBA 史上得分王。

note.en: Left-handed penhold star nicknamed the “Cloud Walker,” and Olympic team gold medalist at Rio 2016 and Tokyo 2020.
